THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5
I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands hereby
declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition
Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose
and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.
Two (02) allotments of land depicted in Advance Tracing No. KU/
KPW/2015/701 dated 26.11.2015 prepared by the Surveyor Gen-
eral of Kurunegala District situated at the village of Assedduma in
the Grama Niladhari's Division of Assedduma – 1158 in the Divi-
sional Secretary's Division of Kuliyapitiya West in Yatikaha Koralaya
South Minor Division in Kurunegala District in North Western Prov-
ince and bounded as follows :
01. Lot 'A' – Paragahamulahena, Thimbirigahapitiyahena,
Kahatagahamulahena, Nagollahena, Nagollawatta and
Kahatagahamulawatta – Extent: 0.0496 Hectare
North: Assedduma Oya; East: Road; South: Paragahamulahena,
Nagollahena, Nagollawatta and Kahatagahamulahena claimed by
M. U. Irantha Silva; West: Paragahamulahena, Nagollahena,
Nagollawatta and Kahatagahamulahena claimed by M. U. Irantha
Silva and Assedduma Oya.
02. Lot 'B' – Paragahamulahena, Thimbirigahapitiyahena,
Kahatagahamulahena, Nagollahena, Nagollawatta and
Kahatagahamulawatta – Extent: 0.5170 Hectare
North and East: Assedduma Oya; South: Paragahamaulahena,
Nagollahena, Nagollawatta and Kahatagahamulahena claimed by
M. U. Irantha Silva and Road; West: Road.
John A.E. Amarathunga,
Minister of Lands.
Ministry of Lands,
‘Mihikatha Medura’,
1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road,
Battaramulla.
29th April, 2016.
